name: IEC timing-relay form: normally open delay on/off
aliases: timing-relay form Normally Open Delay ON/OFF
summary: Timing-relay form form: Normally Open Delay ON/OFF.
description: A timing relay separates the initiating signal from the later change of an output contact. The contact state, delayed transition and reset condition are independent: a timer may have immediate contacts alongside delayed contacts under the same device tag. This entry identifies the normally open delay on/off form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

A control sequence may start an auxiliary before enabling the main load, or keep a fan running after a stop request. Trace supply, trigger and output separately, then draw a timing chart that includes what happens when the trigger ends before a delay has elapsed. The normally-open designation starts with a non-conducting output or open contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state.

The symbol does not supply the time setting, retriggering rule or power-loss behaviour. A three-terminal timing form also needs its actual manufacturer terminal mapping; the vendor name alone does not define a universal pinout.
